nodes.label: TalentsTest.kt
TalentsTest
.`the grade 1 block has the 9 graded talents with BOSS_DAMAGE and ARMOR_PIERCE in place of the retired ones`()
Test
.`the grade 1 units are s, %, points, %, %, points, %, %, dmg and Fúria crescente reads combo-step`()
.`the combo talent reads Limite de dano do combo and gives 5 percent a level up to 50`()
.`the click damage percent talent gives 5 percent a level up to 50`()
.`the flat click damage talent gives 1 a level up to 10`()
.`grade 2 and 3 of the flat click damage give 2 and 3 a level`()
.`the critical chance talent gives 5 points a level, 50, 100 and 150 at level 10 of its grades`()
.`the critical damage talent gives 15 percent a level, 150, 300 and 450 at level 10 of its grades`()
.`the points of a first clear stay 2 for a miniboss and 5 for a chapter boss`()
.`the catalog has 3 grades of the 9 talents and Fúria crescente make 28`()
.`a grade is locked until the previous grade is at level 10 and grade 1 is always open`()
.`a locked grade refuses the upgrade`()
.`a grade level costs its grade in points and the spent points add them up`()
.`an unknown talent is not found`()
.`a first clear pays no point for a phase, 2 for a miniboss and 5 for a chapter boss`()
.`the award key names the position so a replay of it has the same key and another position another key`()
.`the points follow the settings`()
.`rules reject a cost below 1 and negative points`()
.`a new player has level 0 and 0 points and every next cost is its grade, 2 for Fúria crescente`()
.`an upgrade with 3 points raises the level by one and spends 1`()
.`the points spent are the sum of the levels`()
.`an upgrade with no available point is refused and changes nothing`()
.`a request made for another level than the stored one is a mismatch and changes nothing`()
.`an upgrade from level 0 of a talent already at 1 is a mismatch`()
.`a talent at level 10 refuses the upgrade as max level and has no next cost`()
.`at level 9 the next cost is 1 and the upgrade reaches 10, which gives the combo talent 50`()
.`the value of a talent is its level times the per level amount`()
.`a seen level must be an integer from 0 to the max level`()
.`stored levels must be in the catalog and between 1 and 10 and the earned points not negative`()
.`the defense break is one talent labelled Quebra de defesa in each grade`()
.`the magical defense break is not in the catalog`()
.`fromStored leaves out a level outside the catalog and spends no point on it`()
.`fromStored leaves out every grade of the magical break`()
.`fromStored keeps every catalog level`()
.`the boss damage chain is labelled Dano contra chefes and gives 20, 40 and 60 at level 10`()
.`the armor pierce chain is labelled Perfuração de armadura and gives 10, 20 and 30 at level 10`()
.`the retired chapter boss time and critical resistance break are not in the catalog`()
.`Fúria crescente is one COMBO talent of 1 a level up to 4, last in the catalog`()
.`Fúria crescente opens at level 10 of COMBO`()
.`a locked Fúria crescente refuses the upgrade`()
.`a level of Fúria crescente costs 2 points`()
.`Fúria crescente at level 4 refuses the upgrade as max level and has no next cost`()
.`a seen level of Fúria crescente must be from 0 to 4`()
.`every prerequisite is a talent of the catalog`()
.`a talent with a prerequisite of its own must have one grade`()
.`fromStored leaves out every grade of the retired chapter boss time and critical resistance break`()
